description: Items extracted from data/sample_transcript.txt, labeled against data/sample_backlog.json. 'verdicts' lists every acceptable verdict; 'ticket' is the ticket a duplicate/conflict/related item must point to.

items.text: Add SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect support for SSO authentication
items.why: Builds what the PLAT-109 research spike investigates

items.text: Start with SAML 2.0 implementation first as Acme Corp needs it for Q1 rollout
items.why: Follows the spike; arguably settles its open question

items.text: Create AuthProvider interface abstraction layer with authenticate(), refresh_token(), validate_session() methods
items.why: New design work

items.text: Password reset emails have 15% failure rate due to shared IP pool flagged by providers
items.why: Bug report against the shipped email service

items.text: Switch email delivery provider to SendGrid or Postmark or obtain dedicated IP
items.why: Replaces the shared SMTP relay the ticket specifies

items.text: 47 support tickets this month about password reset emails not arriving
items.why: Bug report against the shipped email service

items.text: Add rate limiting and CAPTCHA to login endpoint to prevent brute-force attacks
items.why: Adds a login-specific limit on top of the global one

items.text: Login endpoint allows 1000 password attempts per second with no lockout or CAPTCHA
items.why: Security pain point

items.text: Create sandbox mode for SSO integration testing with mock SAML responses
items.why: New testing work for SSO

items.text: Three enterprise customers hitting 100 req/s global rate limit during batch import windows
items.why: Problem report about the ticket's limit

items.text: Implement tiered rate limits: Free 100 req/s, Pro 500 req/s, Enterprise 2000 req/s with burst allowance using token bucket in Redis
items.why: Replaces the single global in-memory limit

items.text: Add rate limit dashboard widget showing current usage vs limit with 80% threshold alerts
items.why: New UI work

items.text: CSV export feature broken for two weeks, times out on datasets over 10,000 rows
items.why: Bug report; arguably shows the 5,000-row design is wrong

items.text: Move CSV export to async job queue with progress notifications
items.why: Replaces the synchronous design

items.text: Settings page layout breaks on screens narrower than 768px, inputs overflow and buttons unreachable
items.why: Problem report against a desktop-only page

items.text: Refactor settings page with responsive grid layout for mobile compatibility
items.why: Changes the desktop-only layout the ticket specifies

items.text: Main dashboard query takes 4.2 seconds on average due to five sequential queries
items.why: Problem report about the ticket's sequential queries

items.text: Parallelize or combine dashboard queries into materialized view to improve performance
items.why: Replaces the sequential queries the ticket specifies

items.text: Add end-to-end tests for critical path: signup, create project, invite member, create first item
items.why: New tests alongside the unit test suite

items.text: Two of last three production incidents would have been caught by end-to-end tests
items.why: Motivation for the e2e tests
